title: The status tag of a contract does not say what Solusi says
cardHint: The real status from Solusi is kept as a tag, because ServiceNow sets Expired by itself. The list shows the tag to set.
cardText: ServiceNow sets "Expired" by itself from the end date, so the real status from Solusi is kept as a tag, for example "S - Concluded" (procedure 2.8, known challenge 4). This list shows the tag to add, change or remove. Contracts terminated in the last 7 days are checked the same way.
subject: contract
